title: A cross-sectional study of the burden and risk factors of impetigo and scabies among children during conflict in the middle area of the Gaza strip
who: Hassan ASM, Barakat AHH, et al. · Scientific Reports
finding: Of 409 children surveyed in the middle area, 87% were diagnosed with impetigo and 36.7% with scabies. Matches the skin-condition signal on this site.
finding_ar: من 409 أطفال في المنطقة الوسطى، شُخّص 87% بالقوباء و36.7% بالجرب. يتفق مع ارتفاع أمراض الجلد في هذا الموقع.

title: War and chronic illness: a health center-based study of Palestinians with non-communicable diseases in Gaza
who: Aldabbour B, Barakat Y, et al. · Conflict and Health
finding: Survey of NCD patients at health centres: hypertension 64.9%, type 2 diabetes 44.4%; 98.0% had been displaced.
finding_ar: مسح لمرضى الأمراض المزمنة في مراكز صحية: ارتفاع ضغط 64.9%، سكري من النوع الثاني 44.4%؛ و98.0% نزحوا.

title: Effects of the October 2023 war on diabetes treatment and medication adherence in Gaza
who: Hejaz HA · Eastern Mediterranean Health Journal
finding: Among diabetes patients studied, access to a health facility fell from 90% before the war to 22%, and medication adherence from 85% to 45%.
finding_ar: بين مرضى السكري في الدراسة: الوصول إلى مرفق صحي انخفض من 90% قبل الحرب إلى 22%، والالتزام بالدواء من 85% إلى 45%.

title: UNRWA's health service in Gaza: Challenges and response to the October 2023 crisis
who: Aljadba G, Elkhatib Z, et al. · Eastern Mediterranean Health Journal
finding: UNRWA's own account of its health service and disease surveillance during the war; useful context for the gaps in reporting.
finding_ar: رواية الأونروا عن خدماتها الصحية ورصد الأمراض خلال الحرب؛ سياق مفيد لفهم فجوات الإبلاغ.

title: Time-series modelling and forecasting of acute watery diarrhoea (AWD) in the Gaza Strip before and during the war in October 2023
who: Ramadan M, Shah SM, Akihiro S · Public Health
finding: Models AWD over time; the outbreak model showed an exponential rise in cases at the onset of the war. The closest independent check on the diarrhoea trend here.
finding_ar: نمذجة زمنية للإسهال المائي الحاد؛ أظهر النموذج ارتفاعاً أسّياً في الحالات مع بداية الحرب. أقرب فحص مستقل لاتجاه الإسهال في هذا الموقع.

title: Public health, war and cross-border challenges: the recent cVDPV2 polio outbreak in Gaza
who: Grotto I, Agha H, et al. · eClinicalMedicine
finding: Reviews the 2024 polio outbreak (one confirmed case in a 10-month-old child); the campaign immunised 560,000 children under 10 by September 2024.
finding_ar: مراجعة لتفشي شلل الأطفال 2024 (حالة مؤكدة لطفل عمره 10 أشهر)؛ حملة التطعيم شملت 560,000 طفل دون العاشرة حتى سبتمبر 2024.

title: Leveraging community insights and navigating logistical challenges: a case study of the 2024 polio vaccination campaign in Gaza, State of Palestine
who: Dwyer H, Hasan MR, et al. · BMJ Global Health
finding: 559,161 children were vaccinated in the first round, 94% of the revised target.
finding_ar: 559,161 طفلاً طُعّموا في الجولة الأولى، أي 94% من الهدف المعدّل.

title: Prevalence and correlates of anxiety, depression, and symptoms of trauma among Palestinian adults in Gaza after a year of war
who: Zughbur MR, Hamam Y, Kagee A, et al. · Conflict and Health
finding: Online sample of adults: 72.7% moderate-to-severe depression, 65% moderate-to-severe anxiety, 83.5% probable PTSD. An online, mostly educated sample, not representative.
finding_ar: عيّنة إلكترونية من البالغين: 72.7% اكتئاب متوسط إلى شديد، 65% قلق، 83.5% اضطراب ما بعد الصدمة المحتمل. العيّنة إلكترونية ومعظمها متعلّم، فليست ممثِّلة.

title: Challenges and risk factors for infectious diseases in Gaza due to the current conflict
who: Boussaa S, Dardona Z, Amane M · Eastern Mediterranean Health Journal
finding: Narrative review of infectious-disease risks (water, crowding, sanitation); no case counts.
finding_ar: مراجعة سردية لمخاطر الأمراض المعدية (المياه، الاكتظاظ، الصرف)؛ بلا أعداد حالات.

title: Multidrug-resistant bacteria amid health-system collapse in Gaza
who: Abu Dalal H, Irfan B, Elmanama A · Lancet Infectious Diseases
finding: Correspondence on antimicrobial resistance in Gaza. We could not read the full text, so we quote no numbers from it.
finding_ar: مراسلة عن مقاومة المضادات الحيوية في غزة. لم نقرأ النص الكامل، فلا ننقل منه أرقاماً.
